request.acceptance_criteria: Every Go fixture that runs git goes through one hermetic helper (no inherited GIT_CONFIG_*, global config, or host maintenance), no test reads the caller's working directory for a repository path, a guard test fails when a new fixture bypasses the helper, and the suite passes in a linked worktree, under the read-only grade, and on Apple git
request.description: Triaged 2026-09-23 from the xte and wne close-outs: TWELVE findings are one defect class - a test measuring its host instead of the tree - found by workers running in linked worktrees, under the read-only grade, and on Apple git 2.50.1 (f4a3888a proposes exactly this sweep). The instances: git auto-maintenance fixtures on hosts whose git never auto-starts maintenance (75456c24, e6926fcb, ec119c6d, 1bb7d876, d43758b0); fixtures pushing to temp repos inheriting the caller's git config (ad9dcff8, ba9cd986 - the review launch's pushInsteadOf); cwd-relative paths in a linked worktree (88c1c497, c2848449, e24708aa - TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo reads the gate before the executor refusal); and zombie-as-alive inside the container (003d902c). Two of these were fixed one at a time on 2026-09-22 (6a12473f); the class keeps producing more. Fix it as a class: a helper every git-running fixture uses, and a guard test that fails when one does not.
request.title: Make the Go test fixtures hermetic: no test reads the host's git, config or working directory
